title: Searching for Answers From the Man Accused of Sabotaging Alaska’s Senate Race
summary: Dan Sullivan, a retired schoolteacher from tiny Petersburg, Alaska, shares a name with the incumbent senator he hopes to defeat. Is he a spoiler trying to divide the Republican vote? We traveled to Alaska to find out.
